active: pending NPC action may be claimed by one explicit execution consumer
claim identity is derived deterministically from action identity and normalized consumer identity
second concurrent claim is rejected while a claim is active
claimed actions require exact action and claim identities for completion or release
unclaimed completion and acknowledgement reject actively claimed actions
delivery count persists across release and reclaim for auditability
claims survive world save and are enumerable in stable NPC-instance order

sources.relationship: extends persisted pending-action lifecycle without assigning native execution results

assumptions: execution subsystems present stable consumer identifiers
world-owned NPC metadata remains save-serialized by RuntimeLivingWorldService
safe_fallback: an action with an active unmatched claim remains pending and cannot be completed or acknowledged by another consumer
runtime_impact: prevents duplicate concurrent consumption of NPC action intents
world_state_impact: claim consumer, claim id, and delivery count persist on the world-owned NPC instance
native_dependency: timeout and retry policy remain blocked for final native exhaustion
